newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak cbank sets one-week repo, min rate 8.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak cbank sets one-week repo, min rate 8.8 pct.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) on Tuesday set a one-week repo tender to add market liquidity of a fixed volume of one billion crowns.
The minimum rate in the tender was set at 8.8 percent, equal to the discount rate, a central bank statement said.
The NBS added 2.5 billion crowns into the local money market through a seven-day repo tender on Monday, with average yield at 15.96 percent.
The central bank monitors market liquidity on a daily basis and decides each morning whether to hold any open market operations.
According to NBS figures, the Slovak banking sector lacked some 1.87 percent of the funds needed to meet minimum reserves requirements on July 14.
